44/S0.subgoal: Introduce the scope of the lecture and review previous topics on prototyping and expert evaluation.

44/S1.subgoal: Describe the process and requirements of user evaluation as a third quick evaluation technique.

44/S2.subgoal: Identify the major challenges related to questionnaire design and data collection when using user evaluation.

44/S3.subgoal: List established questionnaires used for collecting post-task and post-session feedback.

44/S4.subgoal: Explain the structure and usability metrics measured by the After Scenario Questionnaire (ASQ).

44/S5.subgoal: Describe the construction and scoring methodology of the System Usability Scale (SUS).

44/S6.subgoal: Compare the detailed feedback provided by expert evaluation versus user evaluation.

44/S7.subgoal: Identify specific questionnaires designed to measure cyber sickness in immersive experiences.

44/S8.subgoal: Introduce the Majuli VR Tour project as a case study for practical system implementation.

44/S9.subgoal: Detail the technological framework and platforms used in developing the Majuli VR Tour.

44/S10.subgoal: Explain the optimization strategies used to reduce application size for different deployment platforms.

44/S11.subgoal: Describe the different implementation types of the Majuli VR Tour, including 360-degree imagery and 3D models.

44/S12.subgoal: Summarize the lecture content and introduce the next topic: empirical usability evaluation.
